verdicts.reason: A: the attribution 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' is shrunk to tiny, barely readable text, while the logo is blown up far beyond its original size and sits on the same line as the attribution, so it outweighs it. The can is also small inside a big, mostly empty circle. B: the attribution stays readable and the logo sits under the product, which groups them sensibly. Its flaws are a 5-line quote with awkward breaks ('a / little bitter,'), a logo that is still oversized, and a circle pushed into the top-right corner and cropped, which leaves dead space below it on the right.
